conviction_note: Near-non-result: the findings are small, point both ways, and rest on public documents or proxies against a single-source $0.35 bar, so p_up is 53. abs_move_pct is 7.0, below the 11.4% historical median because the last two prints moved only +2.45/-2.72 and 20d realised vol is 20%, but raised from that recent calm because this is the new CEO's first full quarter and a strategy or guidance reset on the 10-22 call is plausible. The scaled +0.42 and the findings sum of +0.6 agree in sign and size.
bar: Q3 2026 EPS consensus $0.35, one source (Earnings Whispers, https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/EGBN, page read 2026-10-21; the sweep row also gives ~$0.35). For Q2 the sources disagreed ($0.33 at Earnings Whispers, $0.34 at investing.com), so the bar is not confirmed by two agreeing sources and every finding is capped small. Company guidance from the Q2 call, as summarised by investing.com (https://www.investing.com/equities/eagle-bancorp): 2026 NIM 2.6-2.7%, noninterest expense down 7-11% YoY, lower provisions in H2 2026, balance-sheet contraction to stabilise in H2. Q2 actual: EPS $0.23 (net income $6.9M), provision $21.4M, NIM 2.52% (SEC 8-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001050441/000105044126000088/final-erq2x2026xearnings.htm). The $0.35 bar already assumes a large drop in provisions from Q2.
positioning_check: Short interest 3.1M shares, 10.3% of float, 8.1 days to cover, up 4.5% month over month (Equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/EGBN, read 2026-10-21; the page gives no settlement date, and its short-volume figure is dated 2026-10-20). The sweep row has ~8.8% of float and ~7.9 days (Equibles snapshot ~2026-08-20), and 12.1 days at FINRA 2026-08-14. That is a moderately crowded short that is growing into the print. There is no usable skew: the option chain is unusable (ATM spread 194% of mid, 169 contracts of open interest), so the market states no direction. The tape: spot $28.53, 2.1% below the 52-week high, +80.6% off the low, +3.9% over 5 days, +1.7% over 20 days. 13F holders for Q2 2026: T. Rowe Price +1.30M shares, Sixth Street a new 554k stake, AllianceBernstein +369k, North Reef -992k (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Eagle+Bancorp+Announces+Third+Quarter+2026+Earnings+Conference+Call). Insider Form 4s since July are all non-directional: CEO inducement grants 08-10, a CFO transfer to his trust 10-06, tax withholding on 10-15 (EDGAR).

findings.finding: Since the Q2 print EagleBank has been hiring for growth: a CRE market executive (2026-09-09), a Baltimore commercial banking expansion with two hires (2026-09-16), and on 2026-10-15 a newly created 'Senior Director of CRE Strategic Growth' role filled from Truist to 'accelerate CRE growth' and build new CRE lines. For a bank that shrank loans 4.6% QoQ in Q2 to de-risk office CRE, this is a pivot to growth. It suggests management thinks classified-asset resolution is far enough along to stop shrinking, consistent with the guide that contraction stabilises in H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior instance of a growth pivot. The reactions came during the credit-cleanup era: -21.2% (2025-07) and -12.5% (2025-10) on credit, +16.0% (2026-01) on the turn, and +2.45% on 2026-07-22 despite an EPS miss, on de-risking progress.
findings.why_not_priced: Each item is a minor hiring release (Rhea-AI rated it 'Impact Low'), and no sell-side note was found tying it to the loan-growth outlook. If it were priced as a growth turn, consensus would show loan growth, and the stock already sits at the 52-week high, so part of it may be in the price. The hiring is my inference about the outlook, not a company-stated number.
findings.independence: Baltimore expansion release, a separate document: https://www.stocktitan.net/news/EGBN/eagle-bank-expands-commercial-banking-presence-in-36lkcjclvkky.html. The H2 stabilisation guide comes from the Q2 call summary: https://www.investing.com/equities/eagle-bancorp

findings.finding: The company's 2026 NIM guide of 2.6-2.7% (Q2 call) against H1 actuals of 2.47% (Q1) and 2.52% (Q2) requires an H2 average of about 2.7-2.9%, a step-up of roughly 20-35bp from Q2. Q3 NIM below about 2.65%, or a trimmed full-year range, would read as a guide miss. Q2 NII also fell to $62.4M from $63.7M as the balance sheet shrank.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-22 NIM rose 5bp with an EPS miss and the stock rose 2.45%. NIM has not been the line the large reactions turned on; credit was.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic that the full-year range implies a steep H2 ramp is not stated in the summaries found. If the market doubted the guide, consensus EPS would sit nearer Q2's run-rate. The $0.35 bar is a 52% step-up from $0.23, which assumes both lower provisions and a better NII. This is inference from the guide, since the Q3 NIM itself is not known.
findings.independence: The Q2 NIM and NII figures come from the SEC 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001050441/000105044126000088/final-erq2x2026xearnings.htm), a different document from the guide summary.

findings.finding: The Washington DC office market weakened again in Q3 2026. Cushman & Wakefield's Q3 MarketBeat (2026-10-08) puts vacancy at 23.5%, up 20bp QoQ and 140bp YoY, with net absorption of -123,800 sf, Class B vacancy at 28.4% and asking rents down YoY. That pressures the collateral behind EagleBank's office book, where performing office coverage is 7.22%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Office credit drove the -21.2% (2025-07-23) and -12.5% (2025-10-22) reactions. In 2026 nonperforming assets fell (130.8 to 113.1M in Q2) and the stock rose 2.45%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a broad, public, slow-moving series, so it is likely largely priced. The change is incremental (+20bp), and the transmission to EagleBank's specific loans is unconfirmed. If the market feared a new office leg, the stock would not sit 2% off its high.
findings.independence: Proxy only; the company has not confirmed it. none

findings.finding: The Q2 release disclosed that after quarter-end one loan with a $35.4M balance was paid off in full. That reduces Q3 problem or concentrated exposure without a loss. Total criticized and classified loans including held for sale fell to $759.6M from $794.1M in Q2, and nonperforming assets fell $17.7M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-22 falling NPAs and classified loans, with an EPS miss on provisions, gave +2.45%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced, since it was disclosed in July. It is filed because it lands on Q3 credit metrics, the line the stock trades on. The release does not say whether the loan was criticized.
findings.independence: Same document as the classified-loan figures; one reading.

findings.finding: Hovde Group initiated EGBN at Buy with a $37 target (about 30% above the $28.53 spot) around 2026-10-07/09, the highest target on the stock. The prior targets were Piper Sandler Hold $30 (06-26) and Raymond James Buy $32 (05-12). That raises the bar of expectations into the print.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced. The stock rose about 3.9% over the 5 days before the seal, near the 52-week high. A bullish initiation into a print can also raise the bar.

findings.finding: Short interest is 3.1M shares, 10.3% of float, 8.1 days to cover, and rising into the print (+4.5% MoM; FINRA showed 12.1 days on 08-14). The stock trades about 360k shares a day, so a clean credit print can force covering over a one-session window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-21: +16.0% on the credit turn, with shorts likely elevated (the short level then is unsourced).
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is a mechanism, not information: it amplifies a positive surprise and dampens a negative. The settlement date of the figure is unclear.
findings.independence: Sweep row: FINRA 2026-08-14 at 12.1 days to cover, per Curved Trading (no URL here; the Equibles snapshot is the same source family).

findings.finding: Long-only institutions accumulated in Q2 2026: T. Rowe Price +1.30M shares (+339%), Sixth Street a new 554k stake, AllianceBernstein +369k, while North Reef cut 992k and Fourthstone and Jane Street exited. Ownership rotated toward long-horizon holders who are more likely to hold through a noisy print.
findings.why_not_priced: The 13F data are public since mid-August and are stale by a quarter. Equibles shows Q3-dated changes as net 'Distributing' (-69k shares), which partly offsets this.
findings.independence: Equibles shows the opposite drift for Sep 30 (https://equibles.com/stocks/EGBN), so the evidence is mixed.

baseline_tension: The baseline gives no option or skew statement. The stock is near its 52-week high after a +3.9% 5-day run-up, which implies a credit-normalisation story is already priced. My findings lean only slightly positive, mostly on positioning (rising shorts) and the growth-hiring inference, so p_up stays close to 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6: the bar has one source (Q2 sources disagreed), so every finding stays capped small.

Lesson 5: the growth-hiring inference went from +0.5 to +0.4 and the DC office vacancy proxy from -0.4 to -0.3, as proxy or inference rather than company numbers. The NIM-guide arithmetic went from -0.6 to -0.5 for the same reason.
Lesson 7: on a moderately crowded, rising short (10.3% of float, 8 days to cover) the negatives were kept small and the squeeze mechanism was filed as its own positioning finding.
Hovde initiation went from +0.3 to +0.2 because the 5-day run-up already reflects it, and a high target can raise the bar.
abs_move_pct went from 6.5 to 7.0 because the new CEO's first full-quarter call makes a strategy or guide change likely (core table, guidance-change row).
